title: Hudson Valley City Among Least Vegan-Friendly Cities In America - NewsBreak
text:
By Tigman ,
2 hours ago Google Maps A popular area city in the Hudson Valley is not very vegan-friendly according to recent data.
“Vegan-friendly” means a product, meal, or establishment avoids animal-derived ingredients. A vegan-friendly food or product does not contain meat, dairy, eggs, honey, or other animal-based ingredients, but the level of commitment can vary; it can range from a product that’s free of animal ingredients to an entire business that’s certified as inclusive to vegans by offering a significant number of plant-based options.
Also See: “ARIADNE” Sotted On Hudson River Under Night Skies Yonkers, NY, is described as a vibrant, diverse city in Westchester County, known for its strategic location as a gateway to both New York City and the Hudson Valley, its significant history of innovation, and its mix of urban amenities and natural beauty.
As the largest city in Westchester and the fourth largest in New York State, Yonkers offers a wide array of residential options, from waterfront luxury to historic neighborhoods, along with robust shopping, dining, and entertainment, including the Hudson River Museum, Empire City Casino , and numerous parks. The city also has a strong economic base and a reputation for being a diverse and growing community, with major infrastructure projects and a growing population.
According to one study though, Yonkers is not very vegan-friendly as it rates at the bottom of the list.
Researchers from price comparison site Pricelisto.com studied 125 major U.S. cities to find out where vegans have the most options. Orlando came out on top, offering more than 200 restaurants with vegan choices for every 100,000 residents, more than any other city in the rankings.
The study looked at four things: how many vegan-friendly restaurants a city has, how highly they’re rated, how often people search for vegan-related terms, and how many reviews each restaurant receives on average.
The 10 most vegan-friendly cities in America

Miami, Florida 73.58 7. Scottsdale, Arizona 72.93 8. Las Vegas, Nevada 72.91 9. St. Louis, Missouri 72.47 10. Seattle, Washington 72.27 Download the WPDH Mobile App Now The 10 least vegan-friendly cities in America
Rank City Score
125. Hialeah, FL 27.70
124. Yonkers, NY 29.24
123. North Las Vegas, NV 29.84
122. Moreno Valley, CA 30.26
121. Santa Ana, CA 30.82
At the bottom of the rankings, Hialeah, Florida came in last with an overall score of just 27.7. Yonkers, North Las Vegas, Moreno Valley, and Santa Ana made up the rest of the bottom five, all scoring below 31 out of 100.
Why Yonkers May Seem Less Vegan-Friendly Size and Density: Yonkers is a large city, but it is not as densely populated or as much of a cultural hub as Manhattan or Brooklyn, which have a high concentration of vegan restaurants. Demand and Market: A larger vegan population in a city creates higher demand for vegan options, which encourages more businesses to cater to this market. Yonkers’ vegan population is likely smaller than that of NYC. Specialized Businesses: Major cities often have numerous fully vegan restaurants, alongside a wide variety of restaurants with extensive vegan options on their menus. Yonkers may have fewer of these specialized establishments. In summary, Yonkers is not inherently “anti-vegan,” but it’s natural that it has fewer dedicated vegan establishments and options compared to the major urban centers in the area.

The Best Delis You Must Try in Westchester, New York According to Yelp reviews, these Westchester delis are to die for. Don't believe me? Check out the glowing reviews left by people like you below! Gallery Credit: Conor Walsh Yelp, Jan B 10) Nick's Corner Market 3.5 Stars 403 Bedford Rd Armonk, NY 10504 (914) 273-1777
"I come here everyday for lunch, as I work right across the street. The staff are all very friendly and the selection is really unexpectedly vast and all very tasty. I usually get 2 or 3 chicken cutlets with a side of mashed potatoes or one of the many other selections like rice with vegetables, mac and cheese, or a wide variety of different pastas/vegetables. This usually all comes to under $10. The selection of drinks and snacks is also very good and fairly priced.
Nick's is a quick and cheap place for a lunch that will fill you up. 10/10 would recommend." Yelp, Schriefer's Armonk Deli & Catering 9) Schriefer's Armonk Deli & Catering 3.5 Stars 459 Main St Armonk, NY 10504 (914) 273-1711
"I've been living for so many years in Armonk and didn't notice this place at all. I have read great grilled cheese in this place and tried it today. Yes and definitely yes. Not greasy at all and I ordered it with bacon which is so crunchy. love crunchy bacon. I have been to other deli or deli like in the town center but Schreifer got it right. The staff in black shirt behind the counter is fast and have nice personality.
The deli is very clean inside and offers other stuff than deli food. They have green juice as well. I will be back for sure to try other stuff.
Price is comparable to other deli in the area. I paid cash so not sure if they still have the 4% credit card charge. Review is based on experience and of course the grilled cheese." Yelp, John M 8) Insalata & Pomidoro 3.5 Stars 111 Bedford Rd Armonk, NY 10504 (914) 219-8811
"I was on my way to an evening function in Parsippany and stopped in Armonk for lunch.
Not knowing the area, I consulted the Yelp app and found myself a few minutes later at Insalata & Pomidora, a terrific Italian deli.
What a choice of foods they have ! Hot sandwiches, cold sandwiches, paninis, wraps, pizzas, salads, and dozens of prepared dishes.
I went with one of the prepared dishes- a great tasting Chicken Scarpariello with sausage slices, onions and peppers served over a nice bed of Farro and vegetables. There were some hot pepper rings mixed in there with the chicken and that gave the dish some definite pizzazz.
I loved my lunch -the chicken and sausage chunks were delicious, the Farro was perfect, and the sauce was spicy and so good. I added a club soda and paid about $12 for a great meal.
You'll love the place - the service was warm and friendly, and it has so many great looking food choices it may take you a while to decide. But the truth is just about anything you choose is bound to be great.
Two things more:
1) You'll find it in the rear of the Elide Plaza, on the right side. It's not really visible from the parking lot, but just walk into the complex and you'll see it soon enough.
2) There is no public restroom." Yelp, Danielle D. 7) Rose Hill Deli 4 Stars 664 Columbus Ave Thornwood, NY 10594 (914) 769-8293
"The recommendations were flying in, so Rose Hill was tested. Four times later, I can accurately depict this establishment for my fans.
Pauly D spinach wrap is fantastic. At this point, it is my go-to subject to change, of course. Not sure why they don't fold the wrap closed at the end, but hey, everyone has a style. The staff is friendly as can be, and the service is fast, honest, and commendable.
Laurie runs the place, and by god, she is a saint. A warm greeting and a feeling of casual acquaintance always helps a sandy go down smoother.
It seems as though the spot is getting the recognition it deserves because it always has a crowd. I am certainly going to continue going in for Sandys and antipasto.
I went for breakfast once, and the BEC did not compete with Frank & Joe's (see previous review). Breakfast ain't for everyone that's okay; I won't hold it against them.
All together, Rose Hill is getting 5. The food is solid, and Laurie great. Keep up the excellent work. I will return." Yelp, Kearsney N. 6) Rocky's Millwood Deli 4 Stars 235 Saw Mill River Rd Millwood, NY 10546 (914) 941-2165
"As local as it gets- this place has been around since my mom was a kid... and there's a good reason for that!
Great hours and really unique original sandwich specials.
They have gluten free bread!!!! If you go gf, ask for extra spread/dressing/sauce.
The place is small and gets pretty busy around peak hours you'd expect, so plan ahead for that. Even when it's crowded, they're still pretty fast!
Grab your sammie and head next door to the playground with the kiddos, or just a short drive away is gedney public park with a great pond, playground, and hiking trails.
FYI: Rocky's is CASH ONLY and has no seating. They do have an ATM (with fees), and there is a Chase bank right across the street." Yelp, Amy P 5) A & S Marketplace 4.5 Stars 681 E Main St Mount Kisco, NY 10549 (914) 241-6919
"The place to go for everything a Italian deli should be. Plus the meat counter is great. Got a Fillet of beef for Christmas dinner and it was perfect. also you have to try the Chicken cordon bleu, Delicious !!! Thanks Joe and crew !! Fresh Mozzarella, Artichoke hearts, Olives etc. The best for your antipasti" Yelp, Elliot K 4) M & R Deli 4.5 Stars 135 E Main St Mount Kisco, NY 10549 (914) 666-5734
"Perhaps the best "old school" deli in Westchester County. Nothing fancy here -- just great food served by pros who take pride in being the best sandwich shop in the area. I recently ordered a prosciutto and salami with fresh mozzarella, and both hot and sweet peppers. My mind was blown from the first bite to the last. Close your eyes and you're biting into a sammy from the glory days of Author Avenue in the Bronx or Little Italy in Manhattan. This place is a treasure.
M&R -- Don't ever change." Yelp, Madisyn M. 3) Frank and Joe's Deli of Pleasantville 4.5 Stars 76 Wheeler Ave Pleasantville, NY 10570 (914) 747-1349
"Visited Pace and came across this spot for sandwiches. They also sell fresh pastas also. The sandwiches are pretty gosh darn good. Yes, I said it!! lol And it was not an arm and a leg!! I have an 18 year old that's 6'1 so have to watch those coins!
During the 90's I used to visit a tiny Italian store in Austin street that made fresh sandwiches and sold imported Italian food staples. Frank and Joe's remind me of that store. Great bread, fresh cold-cuts and the added veggie are cut thin which I love. Fast and fresh. I will make another drive to grab a sandwich and maybe check out the fresh pasta." Yelp, Jess L 2) Mona Lisa Salumeria 4.5 Stars 829 Post Rd Scarsdale, NY 10583 (914) 723-3493
"Wow! This is an exceptionally outstanding Italian Deli. Everything I've purchased here has been consistently fantastic. I love their lasagna snd stuffed shells with ricotta and spinach as well as their stuffed zucchini with breadcrumbs and ricotta cheese. They have aged Parmesan cheeses and will personally grate to whatever texture you'd like. My wife loves their marinated artichoke stems that are wonderful in salads. And best of all, the two guys who manage the shop, Chris and Mike will go out of their way to assist every customer that walks into their store. They also make all kinds of delicious sandwiches, paninis and soups! You have to go and check out their wonderful selection of pastas, cookies, olive oils and other Italian specialties!" Yelp, Sara L. 1) Dominic's Delicatesesen 5 Stars 15 N Broadway Tarrytown, NY 10591 (914) 524-0505
"Fantastic NY deli that I'd come back in a heartbeat!
First off, amazing staff...the lady behind the counter taking our order was friendly and funny and helped us navigate ingredients when they ran out of some of the sandwiches, while the gentlemen making the sandwiches were truly connoisseurs.
I really wanted the Signature #5 but the last one was ordered right in front of me (ugh!). Instead, I ordered an Italian hero while my wife ordered the Hot Roast Beef (Signature #2 - w/ Muenster cheese, hot peppers, grilled onions). Of course we had to add a mac salad side. Both sandwiches were delicious - well seasoned and loaded with the fixings. The mac salad was excellent. We should have ordered a pint! Very reasonably priced and even better given how big the sandwiches were (~$28 after tip for 2 large heroes and the mac).
We will have to make a special trip back just to try the #5!"
